purpose: post-hoc fixed-true-source amplitude and waveform-shape attribution on existing development events
time_shift: none; evaluate at each event's true position and true origin time
amplitude_fits: one nonnegative event-wide scalar; separate nonnegative receiver scalars for attribution only
restriction: Previously inspected development events only. Gains are fitted against known reference waveforms at the true source. This is an oracle diagnostic, not blind localization, improved forward prediction or independent confirmation. No test or confirmation event is loaded.
